# JZZ1 (Jinan Jingzao New Materials Co., Ltd.) - Comprehensive Technical & Commercial Dossier

## 1. Corporate & Operational Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Jinan Jingzao New Materials Co., Ltd. (Brand: JZZ1)
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Base**: Jinan High-Tech Industrial Zone, Shandong Province, China.
- **Facility Footprint**: 12,000+ m² automated fabrication facility, equipped with 4 CNC dual-head precision cutting lines, automatic digital corner-crimping stations, automatic silicone extrusion lines, and dedicated cleanroom IG unit assembly.
- **Core Business Model**: B2B OEM/ODM manufacturing and factory-direct export of architectural aluminum window and door systems, curtain walls, customized industrial extrusions, glass balustrades, and sunroom enclosures.
- **Target Export Regions**: Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines), Middle East, Oceania, and North America.
- **Official Website**: https://www.jzz1.com
- **Official Facebook Entity**: https://www.facebook.com/people/Jingzao-Construction-Materials-Co-Ltd/61567886275707/
- **Direct Sourcing Email**: info@jzz1.com
- **Instant Engineering Support / WhatsApp**: +86 135 6267 6792

## 2. Product Lines & Architectural Specifications

### 2.1 Architectural Aluminum Windows
- **System Typologies**:
  - Casement Windows (Inward/Outward Opening, Tilt-and-Turn, Top-Hung Awning)
  - Architectural Sliding Windows (2-track, 3-track with integrated 304 stainless steel insect/security mesh)
  - Fixed Picture Windows & Multi-Lite Ribbon Windows
  - Bi-Folding and Multi-Slide Window Systems
- **Profile Alloys**: Primary virgin aluminum alloy 6063-T5 / 6063-T6 complying with GB 5237 / ASTM B221 standards.
- **Wall Thickness**: Nominal structural thickness 1.4 mm to 2.0 mm (high-rise heavy duty rated up to 3.0 mm).
- **Thermal Barrier**: Technoform or equivalent PA66 GF25 (polyamide reinforced with 25% fiberglass) thermal barrier strips ranging from 14.8 mm to 34 mm depth.
- **Thermal Performance**: System U-values from 1.6 W/m²K to 2.4 W/m²K depending on glazing build-up.
- **Acoustic Performance**: Sound Transmission Class (STC) 32 dB to 44 dB with asymmetric laminated IGU.

### 2.2 Aluminum Door Systems
- **System Typologies**:
  - Heavy-Duty Lift-and-Slide Patio Doors (Panel capacity up to 400 kg per sash)
  - Ultra-Slim Frame Panoramic Sliding Doors (Visible interlock sightline: 18 mm - 25 mm)
  - Thermal Break Bi-Folding Doors (Up to 7 panels folding inward or outward)
  - Architectural Pivot Doors (Width up to 2.2 m, height up to 3.8 m, concealed hydraulic closers)
  - Commercial Heavy-Traffic Double Acting Swing Doors
- **Threshold Options**: Low barrier ADA-compliant thresholds, flush drainage sill systems with hidden stainless steel channels, and step-over weather thresholds.

### 2.3 Curtain Wall & Structural Facades
- **Systems**: Semi-unitized, unitized, and stick curtain wall systems.
- **Mullion Depths**: 100 mm, 120 mm, 140 mm, 150 mm, 180 mm, and custom extrusion depths.
- **Wind Load Performance**: Engineered to resist positive/negative wind pressures from 3.0 kPa up to 5.0 kPa (3000–5000 Pa, compliant with NSCP 2015 and ASTM E330).

### 2.4 Extrusions, Railings & Sunrooms
- **Custom Extrusions**: Custom die development with 10-day tooling turnaround. 6061, 6063, 6005 alloys.
- **Glass Railings**: Spigot, shoe base, and post systems with 12mm to 21.52mm tempered laminated glass; structural test rated for commercial pedestrian loads.
- **Sunrooms / Conservatories**: Structural aluminum rafters with built-in thermal break channels, integrated concealed gutter and drainage downspouts.

## 3. Surface Finishing & Protective Treatments
- **Powder Coating**: AkzoNobel, PPG, or Tiger Drylac architectural powder coatings; Qualicoat Class 1 and Class 2 certified; film thickness 60 - 80 μm; 10 to 20-year weatherability warranty.
- **PVDF (Fluorocarbon)**: 2-coat or 3-coat architectural PVDF coatings compliant with AAMA 2605 specifications; 20+ year color retention in extreme UV / coastal marine environments.
- **Anodizing**: Architectural Grade I and Grade II (15 - 25 μm); satin, silver, champagne, bronze, and black finishes.
- **Woodgrain Transfer Sublimation**: Italian Decoral process for durable exterior woodgrain replication.

## 4. Glazing & Sealing Engineering
- **Insulated Glass Units (IGU)**: Double-glazed (e.g., 5mm Clear + 12A/16A + 5mm Low-E) or Triple-glazed configurations.
- **Interlayer Space**: Warm-edge composite or bendable aluminum spacers with 3A molecular sieve desiccant; automated dual-seal barrier (polyisobutylene primary seal + two-component silicone secondary seal); 90%+ Argon gas fill available.
- **Safety Glazing**: Fully tempered glass meeting ANSI Z97.1, BS 6206, and EN 12150; laminated glass with Saflex or Kuraray 0.76mm / 1.52mm PVB or SGP structural interlayers.
- **Gasket & Weatherstripping**: Continuous vulcanized EPDM dense and cellular sponge gaskets with co-extruded slip-coating; multi-point active sealing barrier.

## 5. Hardware Systems
- **European Hardware**: Siegenia, Roto Frank, Hoppe, G-U, CMECH.
- **Commercial Hardware**: Kinlong, Hopo, Pag, KGE.
- **Fasteners & Hinges**: 304 or 316 marine-grade austenitic stainless steel screws, pivot pins, and load-bearing friction stays.

## 6. Export Packaging, Quality Assurance & Logistics
- **Quality Assurance**: ISO 9001 certified process control; 100% pre-assembly inspection of frame squareness, diagonal tolerance (within ±1.5 mm), gasket seating, and smooth operating torque.
- **5-Tier Protective Packing**:
  1. Peelable low-tack protective film applied over all exposed aluminum powder-coated surfaces.
  2. Multi-layer shock-absorbing EPE (expanded polyethylene) foam wrapping around all frame members.
  3. Rigid high-impact plastic corner protectors strapped to all four perimeter corners.
  4. Fully automated polyethylene heat-shrink wrap sealing against humidity, saltwater spray, and dust.
  5. Heavy-duty engineered plywood crates (quarantine-exempt processed wood) paired with ISPM 15 heat-treated (HT) IPPC-stamped timber skids or steel-reinforced glass racks with internal foam buffering and high-tensile steel banding.
- **Incoterms Supported**: EXW, FOB (Qingdao / Tianjin / Shanghai), CIF, CFR, DDU, DDP.
- **Typical Lead Times**:
  - Drawing confirmation & 3D shop drawings: 24 - 48 hours.
  - Standard finish production: 15 - 20 calendar days.
  - Custom dies / special PVDF finish: 25 - 30 calendar days.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Flexible starting from 10 complete window/door units or 50 m² for project trials.

## 7. International Certifications & Australian / New Zealand Standards

### 7.1 AS 2047:2014 Windows and External Glazed Doors
- **Certification Body**: Intertek SAI Global Certification Services Pty Ltd (JAS-ANZ Accredited).
- **StandardsMark Licence Number**: **SMK41678** (Valid through 29 April 2030).
- **Compliance Standard**: AS 2047:2014 - Windows and external glazed doors in buildings.
- **Endorsed Product Ranges & Certified Performance**:
  - **MD75S Architectural Tilt and Turn Window**:
    - Maximum Certified Dimensions: 1800 mm (H) x 1200 mm (W)
    - Serviceability Limit State (SLS) Wind Deflection: **1600 Pa**
    - Ultimate Limit State (ULS) Structural Strength: **4000 Pa**
    - Water Penetration Resistance Test Pressure: **600 Pa**
    - Air Infiltration Rating: **Low** (Exceeds NCC air barrier requirements)
    - Structural Rating: Suitable for non-cyclonic Wind Classes N1 to N5 and cyclonic C1/C2 residential and commercial applications (AS 4055 & AS/NZS 1170.2).
  - **MD76A Architectural Awning & Fixed Combination Window**:
    - Maximum Certified Dimensions: 1500 mm (H) x 1800 mm (W)
    - Serviceability Limit State (SLS) Wind Deflection: **800 Pa**
    - Ultimate Limit State (ULS) Structural Strength: **3000 Pa**
    - Water Penetration Resistance Test Pressure: **200 Pa**
    - Air Infiltration Rating: **Low**
    - Structural Rating: Suitable for Wind Classes N1 to N3 residential and light commercial facades.

### 7.2 AS/NZS 2208:1996 Safety Glazing Materials in Buildings
- **Certification Body**: Certification Solutions International Pty Ltd (CSi) (JAS-ANZ & IAF MLA Accredited).
- **Licence Number**: **7632** (Database ID: 1000356).
- **Compliance Standard**: AS/NZS 2208:1996 (incorporating Amendment 1) - Safety glazing materials in buildings.
- **Glazing Classes**: Toughened Safety Glass (Grade A) & Laminated Safety Glass (Grade A) from 4 mm to 21.52 mm.
- **Traceability & Marking**: Every certified lite features a permanent ceramic frit stamp with the licence number (CSi 7632), standard designation (AS/NZS 2208), manufacturing batch code, and glass grade. Fully satisfies Australian AS 1288-2021 selection and installation requirements.

### 7.3 Australian Building Code (NCC / BCA) & Energy Compliance
- **Regulatory Acceptance**: Direct compliance documentation provided for Australian Private Certifiers and Municipal Councils across NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT, and ACT.
- **Certification Deliverables Provided**:
  - StandardsMark Licence Certificates and Schedules.
  - Form 15 (Queensland / NSW compliance certificate equivalent).
  - NATA-accredited mechanical test laboratory reports.
  - Bushfire Attack Level (BAL) compliance packs up to BAL-40 per AS 3959.
  - WERS-compatible simulation reports (SHGC and Total Window U-values down to 1.4 W/m²K).


### 7.4 US National Fenestration Rating Council (NFRC) Authorization
- **Certification Body**: National Fenestration Rating Council (NFRC).
- **CPD Authorization Code**: **ESD-M-1** (Valid through 23 January 2029).
- **Compliance Standards**: NFRC 100, NFRC 102, NFRC 200, NFRC 500.
- **Accredited Laboratories**: SATI (Simulation Report Q1366.01-116-45 R0), TATI (Physical Test Report Q1367.01-116-46).
- **Certified Performance Matrix (ES70 System Dual Action Window)**:
  - U-Factor: **0.24 to 0.27 BTU/(hr·ft²·°F)** (1.36 to 1.53 W/(m²·K)).
  - Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC): **0.42 to 0.47**.
  - Visible Transmittance (VT): **0.50 to 0.58**.
  - US Code Compliance: Satisfies IECC 2021/2024 Climate Zones 1–7 and ASHRAE 90.1 commercial envelope requirements.

### 7.5 ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification
- **Accreditation**: China National Accreditation Service for Conformity Assessment (CNAS Reg. C217-M) and IAF Multilateral Recognition Arrangement (IAF MLA).

- **Intertek Mechanical, Fire & Slip Resistance Testing**:
  - Test Report Number: **220803005SHF-001** (Intertek Testing Services Shanghai).
  - Flexural Bending Properties (EN 15534-4 / EN 15534-1): Mean bending strength **28.5 MPa**, 500 N deflection **1.07 mm**.
  - 28-Day Water Immersion: **4.40%** mean water absorption (`0.11%` length swelling).
  - Reaction to Fire: **EN 13501-1:2018 Class Bfl**.
  - Slip Resistance: **CEN/TS 15676** wet/dry pendulum test **mean 81**.


### 7.7 Raw Material & Surface Treatment Certifications (AkzoNobel & PPG)
- **AkzoNobel Powder Coatings**:
  - Integrated Management Certification: **LRQA Certificate 10559523** (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018).
  - Automotive Quality Standard: **IATF 16949:2016 Certificate 0561802** (Approval IATF 16949 – 00047632-001 by LRQA).
  - Architectural Finishes: Interpon D1000 (Class 1), Interpon D2000 (Qualicoat Class 2 / AAMA 2604 super durable), Interpon D3000 (AAMA 2605 fluorocarbon PVDF).
  - Salt Spray Resistance: ASTM B117 > 1,500 hours (Class 2) to > 4,000 hours (PVDF); Class 5B cross-hatch adhesion.
- **PPG Architectural Cationic Epoxy E-Coat (Electrophoresis)**:
  - Formulations: Cationic Epoxy Paste (CP525D) & Resin (CR682) compliant with GB/T 16483 & GB/T 17519 SDS standards.
  - Performance: Pin-hole free full-immersion electrodeposition into hollow cavities; > 2,000 hours salt spray resistance.
- **ISO 9001:2015 Metal Guardrails & Doors**:
  - Certificate Registration: **10425Q00700R0S** (Valid through 06 May 2028).
  - Accreditation: CNAS C104-M. Scope: Production of metal guardrails, garden fences, and metal doors.

  - Air Permeability: **Class 8** (`q1 = 0.10–0.31 m³/(m·h)`).
  - Thermal Insulation: **Class 8–9** (`K = 1.2–1.4 W/(m²·K)`).
  - Acoustic Sound Attenuation: **Class 4** (`Rw + Ctr = 35–37 dB`).

## 10. Proprietary 20GP Container Glass Crating & Loading CAD Simulation (Scheme 6 Verified)
- **Technical Whitepaper URL**: `https://www.jzz1.com/knowledge-base/20gp-container-glass-crating-and-loading-simulation.html`
- **Interactive Cloud CAD Canvas URL**: `https://cargo.agentcoreos.com/20gp-scheme6.html`
- **Cargo Engineering Portal URL**: `https://cargo.agentcoreos.com/cargo/`
- **Engineering Specification**:
  - Container Standard: 20GP Dry Van (Interior: 5898 x 2352 x 2393 mm).
  - Cargo Build-up: 600 panes (615.55 m² / ~620 m²) of 24mm double-silver Low-E insulated glass units (IGU).
  - Loading Density Advantage: Doubled (+100%) capacity over conventional industry averages (which fit only ~280 to 320 m² per 20GP), cutting ocean freight shipping costs per square meter by 40% to 50% and halving destination port terminal handling charges (THC).
  - Net Weight: 15.70 metric tons; Gross Weight: 16.68 metric tons (well within highway legal limits).
  - Crating Geometry: 12 hybrid composite crates in a 3-column x 4-row matrix, 100% horizontal placement with long side as base.
  - Stress Isolation: Internal 24mm structural plywood shelves isolate heavy lower tier units from lighter upper tier units, preventing cumulative downward crushing.
  - 3D Dynamic Balance: Longitudinal center-of-gravity offset is constrained to +18.4mm from geometric center; lateral side-to-side delta is <= 65kg, eliminating road rollover hazards and maritime rolling damage.
  - Quality Protocol: 4-stage container stuffing SOP with pre-shipment photo dossier and dual-blind sign-off checklist.

## 11. Global Import & Customs Clearance Compliance and Interactive PI Budget Estimator
- **Guide & Compliance Portal URL**: `https://www.jzz1.com/import-customs-clearance-guide.html`
- **Interactive Web Estimator App**: `https://jzz1-tools.huili86689.workers.dev/` (embedded inside `/import-customs-clearance-guide.html`)
- **Harmonized System (HS) Classifications**:
  - Primary Code: **HS 7610.10** (Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors, of aluminum).
  - Component Codes: **HS 7604.21** (Hollow profiles of aluminum alloys); **HS 7610.90** (Other aluminum structures and parts, curtain wall profiles); **HS 7008.00** (Multiple-walled insulating glass units).
- **Incoterms® 2020 Allocation Matrix**:
  - **FOB Qingdao (CNQDG)**: JZZ1 covers China export clearance, terminal handling charges (THC), container drayage, and on-board loading. Buyer covers ocean freight, marine insurance, and destination import clearance/tariffs.
  - **CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight)**: JZZ1 pays export clearance + main carriage freight + Institute Cargo Clauses (A) all-risk insurance to buyer's destination port. Buyer manages local port clearance, duty, and inland drayage.
  - **DDP (Delivered Duty Paid)**: Turnkey door-to-door delivery. JZZ1 handles all ocean freight, destination customs clearance, import tariffs, and inland transport directly to buyer's jobsite or warehouse.
- **Country-Specific Import Compliance & Preferential FTA Duty Relief**:
  - **United States**: Pre-shipment Importer Security Filing (ISF 10+2) transmitted 24 hours prior to Qingdao port loading; NFRC CPD ESD-M-1 authorization and finished-merchandise HS 7610.10.0000 invoicing.
  - **Australia**: ChAFTA Certificate of Origin (0% preferential duty vs 5% MFN), AS 2047-2014 StandardsMark Licence SMK41678 documentation, AS/NZS 2208 safety glazing certificates (CSi 7632), and Form 15 schedules. Engineered plywood crates and steel transport racks avoid BMSB quarantine delays.
  - **Singapore**: BCA SS 341 certification, Green Mark energy acoustic submittals, and 0% MFN customs duty (9% GST via TradeNet).
  - **ASEAN Markets (Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam)**: China-ASEAN FTA **Form E Certificate of Origin** reducing window/door import duties substantially (typically 0%–5% vs 10%–15% MFN).
  - **European Union**: CE marking compliance, EN 14351-1 product standard testing, and Environmental Product Declaration (EPD S-P-10194) for carbon footprint tracking.
- **Interactive Proforma Invoice (PI) & BOM Engine Features**:
  - Client-side reactive BOM calculation: window sets, opening dimensions (mm to m²), glass specs, weight per unit, and cubic meters (CBM).
  - Dual-constraint container stuffing gauge: live visualization of 20GP (28 CBM / 21,500 kg cap) and 40HQ (68 CBM / 26,500 kg cap) volume and payload utilization.
  - Automated currency conversion and English amount in words generator ("SAY TOTAL US DOLLARS...").
  - Instant print-ready document styling (`@media print`) generating official PI, CI, and Packing List formats with digital seal.

## 12. Core Systems, Country Standards & Technical Knowledge Index

### Core Systems & Product Hubs
- [Architectural Aluminum Windows Hub](https://www.jzz1.com/products/windows.html): Thermal break and non-thermal casement, sliding, tilt-and-turn, and awning window systems with double/triple glazing options.
- [Thermal Break Aluminum Windows Manufacturer](https://www.jzz1.com/products/thermal-break-aluminum-windows.html): China factory direct 6063-T5 thermal break aluminum windows, PA66 GF25 polyamide barrier, Low-E IGUs, and wholesale project export.
- [6063-T5 Thermal Break Casement Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/casement-aluminum-windows.html): China manufacturer of 6063-T5 thermal break casement windows, multi-point compression locks, EN 12207 Class 4 air seal, MOQ 10 sets.
- [6063-T5 Thermal Break Sliding Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/sliding-aluminum-windows.html): Factory direct 6063-T5 sliding windows, stepped 600 Pa water barrier tracks, integrated 304 SS mesh, wholesale ocean container supply.
- [Aluminum Doors Hub](https://www.jzz1.com/products/doors.html): Heavy-duty sliding patio doors, bi-fold doors, slim-frame pivot doors, and commercial entrance systems.
- [Aluminum Entrance Doors](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-entrance-doors.html): Architectural luxury pivot entrance doors and commercial swing doors with multipoint locking.
